title: provider._repository_of cuts a gitlab.com project whose group or name at depth 3 or more is blob, tree, raw or blame to the wrong slug
goal: provider._repository_of reads a gitlab.com url without /-/ such as /a/b/tree/c as the project a/b/tree/c when the API has no project a/b, or tools.md names that the legacy form is cut at the first blob, tree, raw or blame word. Found by the SP-c6tr77jl review (S4, BG-iwqv7nxs gate g1).

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,"_tools");import provider as p;r=p._repository_of(p.urllib.parse.urlsplit("https://gitlab.com/a/b/tree/c"));print(r);sys.exit(0 if r and r[1]=="a/b/tree/c" else 1)

repro_reason: the legacy and the nested reading cannot be told apart from the path alone; the repro reads the slug the code gives for the nested path, with the API stubbed
